title: Use the radial primitive, including the endpoint
promptMarkdown: On $\mathbb R^3$, let $\alpha=(2xy+z)\,dx+x^2\,dy+x\,dz$. Verify that it is closed. Apply the radial homotopy formula for one-forms to construct a primitive, and verify by direct differentiation. Explain what the same homotopy identity says for closed zero-forms.
hintLadder: Compare each pair of cross partials.
Evaluate the one-form at tx on the radial vector x.
Remember that pullback of a positive-degree form by a constant map is zero, but pullback of a function need not be.
